A.explanation: Radial straight lines with arrows pointing inward show the field of a negative point charge.

B.explanation: Radial straight lines with arrows pointing outward show the field of a positive point charge, not a negative charge.

C.explanation: Concentric circular field lines do not represent a radial electrostatic field from a point charge.

D.explanation: Concentric circular field lines do not represent a radial electrostatic field from a point charge.
